sloka: तेषां सञ्जल्पमानानामशोकवनिकां गताम्।अभिदुद्राव वैदेहीं रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।। ६.९३.४५ ।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ sañjalpamānānāmaśokavanikāṁ gatām।abhidudrāva vaidehīṁ rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.93.45 ।।

translations.english: Highly enraged Ravana, darted just as planet Mars rushed to Rohini in the sky, even while his wellwishers were obstructing.
